\chapter{Results}
\section{Theory}
\begin{theorem}[Main result]\label{thm:main}
Every bounded monotone sequence converges.
\end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}
A Cauchy sequence is bounded.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Take $\varepsilon = 1$ and use the triangle inequality.
\end{proof}
\begin{remark}
Theorem~\ref{thm:main} is classical.
\end{remark}
